description: Expander adding two stereo channels to the Form mixer, placed to its left, carrying the main stereo bus, both aux buses and the solo bus without patch cables

params.text: Sets that channel's level on an audio taper: logarithmic over the top three quarters, -18dB at a quarter turn, and straight down to silence below that
Sets the balance of that stereo channel, full left giving the left side full gain and silencing the right, and centre attenuating both by 6dB
Silences that channel, with a smoothing filter that stops the cut from clicking; a solo on any channel of the chain overrides it
Plays that channel alone and clears the solo on every other channel of the chain; control-click, or command-click on a Mac, adds the channel to the solo instead of replacing it
Sets how much of that channel is mixed into aux bus 1, taken after the level, balance and mute controls unless the menu switches send 1 to pre-fader
Sets how much of that channel is mixed into aux bus 2, taken after the level, balance and mute controls unless the menu switches send 2 to pre-fader

inputs.text: The left input of that stereo channel; patched on its own it feeds both sides, and the balance control then pans it between the two direct outputs
The right input of that stereo channel; left unpatched, the left input feeds both sides
Scales that channel's level, 0V silencing it and 10V leaving the level knob alone, smoothed so that fast changes do not click
Shifts that channel's balance, 5V moving it fully right and -5V fully left, added to the balance knob and smoothed so that fast changes do not click
Mutes that channel while the voltage is above 1.6V and un-mutes it below 0.8V, or toggles the mute on each rising edge when the menu is set that way

outputs.text: The left side of that channel after its level knob and mute, carrying none of the other channels
The right side of that channel after its level knob and mute, carrying none of the other channels

notes: with no Form mixer in the row the two channels work on their own, each acting as a stereo VCA with balance, mute and solo
this module has to touch the Form mixer, or another ExTwo or ExFor that reaches it in an unbroken row; a gap breaks the chain and this module is cut off
the three items on the right-click menu apply only to the channels of the module you right-clicked; every expander in the row carries its own copy of them
menu: Send 1 Pre-Fader — takes the aux 1 sends from before the level and balance controls, so the fader no longer changes them while mute and solo do
Send 2 Pre-Fader — takes the aux 2 sends from before the level and balance controls, so the fader no longer changes them while mute and solo do
Mute CV toggles on/off — makes each rising edge at a mute CV jack flip the mute, in place of muting while the gate is high

inputs.8: high above 1.6V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.9: high above 1.6V · stepped · one channel only
